<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet, swim 25 feet; swamp stride

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
_whip_ +11 ([Disarm](/Traits.aspx?ID=175), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=188), [Reach](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [Trip](/Traits.aspx?ID=196)),
**Damage** 1d4+6 slashing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
tongue +10 ([reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** tongue grab

**Divine Prepared Spells** DC 21, attack +11
- **Cantrips (2nd)**
[Chill Touch](/Spells.aspx?ID=35), [Divine Lance](/Spells.aspx?ID=84), [Read Aura](/Spells.aspx?ID=246), [Shield](/Spells.aspx?ID=280)
- **1st**
[Bane](/Spells.aspx?ID=18), [Fear](/Spells.aspx?ID=110), [Harm](/Spells.aspx?ID=146)
- **2nd**
[Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), [Sound Burst](/Spells.aspx?ID=292)

**Swamp Stride**   A boggard scout ignores difficult terrain caused by swamp terrain features.

**Terrifying Croak** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [Emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [Fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=68), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) The boggard scout unleashes a terrifying croak. Any non-boggard within 30 feet becomes frightened 1 unless they succeed at a DC 19 Will save; those who critically succeed are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

**Tongue Grab**   If the boggard scout hits a creature with its tongue, that creature becomes [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20) by the boggard. Unlike with a normal grab, the creature isn't [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24), but it can't move beyond the reach of the boggard's tongue. A creature can sever the tongue by hitting AC 15 and dealing at least 4 slashing damage. Though this doesn't deal any damage to the boggard, it prevents it from using its tongue Strike until it regrows its tongue, which takes a week.

</column>
